name: external-isolation attenuation of internal source-continuity information

zenodo_318_stress_test.interpretation: source-continuity gain was descriptively weaker in the extreme external-isolation tail

global_5401_mammal_exploratory.interpretation: C advantage was geographically broad but weakened as response-independent external isolation increased

core_statement: Species-conditioned internal source continuity can retain nonredundant occurrence information beyond island state and direct/diffuse occupied-source context, but that incremental information should attenuate rather than amplify toward extreme external isolation.

mechanistic_working_model.source_network_depletion: As external isolation increases, the set of plausible occupied insular sources becomes sparse, truncated, or effectively absent, so graph-path structure has less variation left to explain beyond R3.
mechanistic_working_model.state_filter_dominance: At extreme isolation, historical and environmental filters may dominate occurrence strongly enough that fine internal source topology contributes less incremental prediction.
not_claimed: confirmation by the current GIFT terminal fresh attempt

future_independent_test.required_data: a response-sealed island occurrence system independent of A-Islands, the 318-island mammal test, the 5401-island mammal analysis, boreal beetles, and the consumed GIFT plant lane
future_independent_test.C_adds_only: training-only internal source-continuity or graph-path features beyond R3
future_independent_test.source_features: leave the complete held-out validation block out of all source-derived predictors
future_independent_test.validation_unit: response-independent archipelago or spatial block frozen before response access

prospective_primary_for_future_system.estimand_1: equal-weight validation-block mean C-minus-R3 log loss
prospective_primary_for_future_system.estimand_1_support: point estimate < 0 and frozen block-bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0
prospective_primary_for_future_system.estimand_2: Spearman association across validation blocks between block-mean C-minus-R3 and response-independent external isolation
prospective_primary_for_future_system.estimand_2_direction: positive, because less-negative C-minus-R3 at greater isolation means attenuation
prospective_primary_for_future_system.estimand_2_support: rho > 0 and frozen block-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
prospective_primary_for_future_system.joint_support: both estimand_1 and estimand_2 support rules must pass
prospective_primary_for_future_system.anti_rescue: failure of either component cannot be rescued by taxon, island type, tail threshold, or subgroup analyses
